title: Service Operations Specification for the Workplace Cafe Management Program Service Models
content:
Workplace Cafe Management Program — Service Operations Specification

1. This annex fixes the operating specification run at the cafe counter under each service model of the Workplace Cafe Management Program: the operating days served each week, the meal periods served each operating day, the hours of counter service per operating day, the minimum culinary and service headcount staffed in full-time equivalents, the billed labour rate per full-time-equivalent hour, the length of the published menu rotation, the number of serving stations operated, the number of till terminals installed, whether mobile ordering ahead is included, whether catering may be ordered out of the cafe kitchen, the registered dietitian hours included each month, the depth of the allergen programme run at the cafe, and whether monthly waste diversion reporting is included.
2. The figures are read against the service model printed on the cafe management contract for the site.

| Service model | Operating days per week | Meal periods per day | Counter service hours per day | Minimum staffing (FTE) | Billed labour rate (USD per FTE hour) | Menu cycle (weeks) | Serving stations | Till terminals | Mobile ordering ahead | Catering from the cafe kitchen | Dietitian hours per month | Allergen programme depth | Waste diversion reporting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 5 days | 1 | 10.0 hours | 0.5 FTE | 24.8 USD | 2 weeks | 1 | 1 | No | No | 0 | standard | No |
| Limited Service Cafe | 5 days | 1 | 6.5 hours | 1.5 FTE | 26.4 USD | 3 weeks | 2 | 1 | No | Yes | 0 | standard | No |
| Full Service Cafe | 5 days | 2 | 9.0 hours | 4.0 FTE | 28.15 USD | 4 weeks | 4 | 3 | Yes | Yes | 4 | enhanced | Yes |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 5 days | 3 | 12.0 hours | 9.5 FTE | 31.75 USD | 5 weeks | 7 | 5 | Yes | Yes | 12 | enhanced | Yes |
| Executive Dining Service | 5 days | 2 | 8.0 hours | 6.0 FTE | 36.9 USD | 6 weeks | 3 | 2 | Yes | Yes | 8 | dedicated | Yes |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 7 days | 3 | 16.0 hours | 22.0 FTE | 30.25 USD | 6 weeks | 12 | 9 | Yes | Yes | 24 | dedicated | Yes |

Operating days per week hold at five for every service model except Campus Dining Commons Service, which serves seven days a week. Counter service hours per day, minimum staffing and the billed labour rate all rise with service model tier, though Grab & Go Cafe Service carries longer counter service hours per day than Limited Service Cafe despite the smaller minimum staffing, reflecting a single-station counter kept open across a long window with light staffing. The allergen programme depth reads standard at the two lightest models, enhanced at Full Service Cafe and Culinary Center Cafe, and dedicated at Executive Dining Service and Campus Dining Commons Service.

Consider a hypothetical client site staffed under the Executive Dining Service model. The counter would serve two meal periods across 8.0 hours of counter service each operating day, staffed at a minimum of 6.0 full-time-equivalent culinary and service headcount billed at 36.9 USD per full-time-equivalent hour, running a six-week menu cycle across 3 serving stations and 2 till terminals, with mobile ordering ahead and catering from the cafe kitchen both included, 8 registered dietitian hours included each month, a dedicated allergen programme, and monthly waste diversion reporting included.
